children: Kroger
plans to eliminate roughly
corporate jobs over the next three years
, cutting about
37% of its 8,200-person corporate workforce
as the grocery giant integrates artificial intelligence more deeply into its operations.
According to an internal memo cited by Reuters, CEO Greg Foran said the company will provide more details on affected roles in the coming months.
The restructuring is designed to reduce duplicated work, simplify decision-making and adapt to rapid technological change.
Kroger plans to redirect some of the savings toward
lower retail prices and additional investment in store-level employees
, an important move as the company competes with Walmart and Aldi for increasingly price-sensitive shoppers.
The initiative also builds on an earlier round of cost cuts. Kroger eliminated roughly
1,000 corporate roles in June 2025
, meaning the company has now announced plans to remove a substantial portion of its corporate cost base over a relatively short period.
AI is becoming a bigger part of that strategy.

Last month, Kroger outlined an enterprise AI roadmap that includes using AI models to streamline back-office workflows and tapping consumer data to power digital tools such as an AI shopping assistant.
The restructuring comes as Kroger deals with softer demand and competitive pressure.
The retailer recently lowered its annual identical-sales target and indicated that it plans to cut prices to defend market share.
Investor Takeaway
I think the key issue is whether Kroger can use AI to
remove corporate costs without weakening execution at the store level
Cutting 37% of the corporate workforce is substantial, so the savings could meaningfully support margins and give Kroger more flexibility to invest in lower prices.
That matters in grocery, where price perception is critical and Walmart and Aldi continue to compete aggressively.
But there is also execution risk.
Large workforce reductions can disrupt internal processes, while AI tools may not immediately replace every function being eliminated.
For investors, I would watch
SG&A expenses, identical sales, gross margin, price investment and whether Kroger can improve productivity without hurting customer service
If the restructuring works, AI could become a real cost advantage. If not, the savings could be offset by weaker execution and continued competitive pressure.

title: Kroger Workers Face Harsh Reality as 3,000 Jobs Disappear
